description: Known, accepted validation debt. Findings listed here are reported by py/validate_quality.py as WARN (tracked debt) instead of blocking ERROR, so pre-existing problems do not prevent new work from passing its completion gate. Anything NOT listed here still blocks. Run with --no-baseline to see the unsuppressed truth.
rules: Every entry must carry a reason and an owner action. Debt is tracked, not forgiven.
Do not add an entry to silence a finding produced by work you just did. This file is for pre-existing debt only.
Remove an entry the moment the underlying problem is fixed; the validator reports stale entries.

entries.reason: National 2008 row cites metadata index 31, a WHO multi-country situation report published 29 Oct 2025 covering 2025-01-01..2025-09-28. A 2025 document cannot substantiate 2008 data, so the citation is wrong; the underlying case numbers may still be correct.
entries.action: Identify the source that actually supports Angola's 2008 national figures (WHO AFRO bulletin or WER for that year), re-register it, and repoint source_index. If no source can be found, reduce confidence_weight and mark the row provisional.

Migori County row cites metadata index 16, titled 'Kenya Homa Bay County 2015 Outbreak'. Migori and Homa Bay are adjacent Nyanza counties and a single 2015 report may cover both, but the citation as written names a different county than the row.
entries.action: Check whether the cited Homa Bay report also reports Migori. If it does, widen the metadata Source/Description; if not, find the Migori source.
